exceptions.justification: tough-cookie is a transitive dependency of a test-only HTTP recorder. The prototype-pollution path requires attacker-controlled cookie names, which never reach it inside a recorded test fixture. There is no production exposure.
exceptions.alternatives: Upgrade is blocked until the recorder ships a release compatible with tough-cookie >=4.1.3 (tracked upstream). Re-evaluate on its next minor; drop this waiver once resolved.

exceptions.justification: The semver ReDoS only triggers on untrusted version strings; every version string this repository parses comes from package.json files it authors.
